name: Skincare Consultation
subtitle: Healthy, glowing skin
description: Take a closer look at your skin with personalized guidance from a skincare specialist. Discuss concerns such as acne, dryness, sensitivity, uneven tone, pigmentation, or signs of aging. Together, you can identify suitable skincare routines, products, and professional treatments designed to support healthier, clearer, smoother, and more radiant-looking skin.

name: Body Treatment Consultation
subtitle: Tailored body treatments
description: Discover body care options tailored to your individual needs, concerns, and desired results. During your consultation, discuss areas such as uneven skin tone, dryness, texture, body acne, pigmentation, or general skin maintenance. A specialist will help you understand available treatment options and recommend suitable approaches for a personalized body care experience.
